Ragdoll Hit is a physics-based action and fighting video game developed by Ericetto (and also released by Kids Games LLC on mobile platforms) where players control floppy stickman characters in chaotic 1-player or 2-player battles. 
Google Play
 +3
Gameplay & Mechanics
Physics-Driven Combat: Every movement, punch, kick, and fall relies on real-time gravity and momentum, making each match unpredictable and unique. 
Controls: Move and strike using the A/D or Left/Right arrow keys, jump with W or the Up arrow, kick with S or the Down arrow, and pick up or hold items using the Spacebar. 
Environment & Weapons: Players can use surrounding terrain, environmental hazards (like hanging TNT or spiked wheels), and unlockable weapons (such as swords, bats, hammers, and katanas) to defeat enemies.

Progression: Victories award coins that can be spent on new hero skins and stronger weapons.

Game Modes & Platforms
Single-Player Campaign: Fight through increasingly difficult levels, obstacle courses, and extreme boss fights.
2-Player (PvP) Mode: Compete against a friend locally in intense 1v1 duels.
Platforms: Available directly as a free browser game (on platforms like Poki), as well as a downloadable mobile title on iOS and Android.
